next_task.title: Approved live corpus tests: an opt-in, licence-recorded corpus harness that fails closed without an approval
next_task.objective: Turn the last M002 build item into something that can be run without weakening the offline guarantee: a corpus manifest whose entries each record their licence, origin, and frozen expected typed outcome, a runner that refuses to execute unless every entry carries an owner approval record, and deterministic tests that prove the refusal itself - so that adding an approved corpus later is a data change rather than a code change, and no default test run ever reaches the network.
prerequisites: M002.1 to M002.7 complete (search, acquisition, robots, extraction, snapshots, bounded fetch, diagnostics)
No corpus entry may be added whose licence does not permit local use and whose redistribution status is not recorded
An owner approval record is required before any entry can be executed; the harness must refuse to run without one
Live execution stays opt-in and outside make gate; the default test run must remain deterministic, offline, and stub-only
No sibling code may be copied while the licence gate in docs/REUSE_PROVENANCE.md is unmet
M001 deterministic slice evidence must remain byte-identical
allowed_scope: a corpus manifest format with per-entry licence, origin, approval, and frozen expected typed outcome
a fail-closed gate that refuses to execute an entry without a recorded approval, with a typed refusal naming the reason
deterministic stub-only tests for the manifest, the approval gate, and the offline default
documentation of what a live corpus run would prove and what it would not
forbidden_scope: performing live network access in any default or gated test run
adding corpus entries whose licence or redistribution status is unrecorded
downloading or committing page bodies that may not be redistributed
SQLite, FTS5, retrieval, ranking, answer generation, models, PDF extraction, or UI work
changing the frozen Snapshot, Passage, or extraction refusal definitions
copying sibling source while the licence gate is unmet
done_when: a corpus entry without an approval record is refused with a typed outcome naming the missing approval, proven by test
the manifest records licence, origin, and a frozen expected typed outcome per entry, and rejects an entry that omits any of them
no default or gated test run performs network access, DNS resolution, or reads a live page
make gate passes and evidence is recorded in LOCAL_BROWSER_STATE.md
if no corpus is approved, the blocker is recorded explicitly rather than worked around

product_contract.citation_definition: A typed link from an answer claim to an exact passage in an immutable snapshot; a URL or search snippet alone is not a citation.

nonnegotiable_invariants: Work on one milestone at a time.
Do not weaken a frozen gate after seeing a result.
Search snippets are discovery metadata and never report evidence.
Every factual Evidence UI field names a known claim ID.
Every accepted claim resolves to exact saved passage evidence.
Model output cannot create trusted IDs, executable UI or arbitrary actions.
Local and hosted results remain visibly and analytically separate.
No model, embedding model or reranker is tested without a measured failure and frozen promotion threshold.
Normal users do not need Docker or a terminal.
Documentation checks do not prove runtime behavior.
Never expose secrets, private snapshots, downloaded weights or restricted benchmark bodies.

conditional_experiments.eligible_only_when: labelled passage-recall failures require document-wide context
candidate recall is adequate but ordering is a measured downstream failure
the bounded single-controller design has a demonstrated product failure

before_work: Inspect the working tree and preserve unrelated changes.
Restate the active milestone, proof level and exact gate.
Do not infer that an existing file is built, tested or accepted.
after_work: Update tests, documentation, project.json and LOCAL_BROWSER_STATE.md together.
State which proof level was actually reached.
Leave exactly one eligible next task.
